options.name: go_path
options.description: Path to be used for C(GOPATH), defaults to the target systems C(GOPATH) environment variable

options.name: name
options.description: Name of Go package to install

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the package. C(download) will download the package, but will not install the package.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certificates when downloading packages
